newsitem.title: USA: NHL-BRUINS SIGN FREE AGENT LW BAUMGARTNER.
newsitem.headline: NHL-BRUINS SIGN FREE AGENT LW BAUMGARTNER.

text.p: The Boston Bruins signed rugged 10-year veteran left wing Ken Baumgartner to a three-year contract as free agent signing began Tuesday.
Baumgartner, who became an unrestricted free agent Tuesday, appeared in 67 games last season for the Anaheim Mighty Ducks, compiling 11 assists and 182 penalty minutes.
The tough left winger was acquired by Anaheim in March of 1996 after three-plus seasons with Toronto, then coached by current Bruins coach Pat Burns.
"Ken has a tough, physical presence that we felt we needed," said Bruins assistant general manager Mike O'Connell.

"Pat Burns knows Ken well from his time in Toronto and he feels he will be a good complement to this team. He's a very team-oriented player and he's a veteran who will fit well with the number of young players we expect to have this season."
In 545 career regular-season NHL games with Los Angeles, the New York Islanders, Toronto and Anaheim, the 31-year-old Baumgartner has 12 goals and 37 assists with 1,926 penalty minutes.
